Arabica Beans

Grown above 1,800m in Ethiopia and Colombia, our Arabica beans are slowly cold-processed to preserve their natural antioxidants and complex flavor compounds. High altitude = lower temperature = denser, sweeter, more nuanced beans. The foundation of everything NOIR does.
